steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Key design movements: Art Nouveau (organic, decorative), Bauhaus (functional, geometric), Swiss/International (grid, clarity), Postmodernism (playful, deconstructed). | Key Fact: Understanding design history helps you make informed choices — every style has a context and communicates specific values. | Key Fact: Contemporary designers build on and react against historical movements — understanding the past enriches present practice. | Key Fact: Critical analysis of graphic design considers: audience, purpose, context, techniques, visual language and effectiveness.
